safety-hooks.description: Class A: Safety Hooks (raw-data protection, dangerous command protection, outside-workspace protection)

integrity-hooks.description: Class B: Integrity Hooks (artifact verification, state consistency, manifest verification, post-analysis validation)

learning-hooks.description: Class C: Learning Hooks (capture user correction, capture validation failure, capture agent trajectory)
